picks.catalyst: Same-day sector catalyst for chip equipment: SK Hynix's record quarter (80% operating margin, demand above supply through 2030, long-term deals for over half of 2027-28 capacity) came with a plan to raise capital spending significantly from 2026 levels. AMAT is the strongest large-cap chip-equipment name today: 414.4 at 13:18, +4.7% on the day and +2.7% from the 403.35 open, near the 415.99 high (ASML +1.5%). No AMAT headline of its own; FOMC decision at 14:00 is the risk. Reports in November
